_comment: Coding-agent adapters for xender-pm doctor/dispatch. Only official CLIs. Auth checks run the CLI's own status command; nothing reads credential files. Execution stays OFF unless XENDER_PM_ALLOW_EXEC=1 and doctor reports installed + authenticated. readOnlyArgs: appended for read-only (check) tasks; a CLI without verified readOnlyArgs refuses to auto-run them.

claude.label: Claude Code
claude.install: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code, then run `claude` once and sign in

gemini.label: Gemini CLI
gemini.install: npm install -g @google/gemini-cli, then run `gemini` once and sign in with Google
